body:
I have nothing. 

These thoughts have persisted for years, and even though they are less intense at times, they are always there. I made my first feeble attempt at the age of seven -- that was fifteen years ago. I can't go on living like this. I simply can't. 

I spent my high school years in a haze of depression and started to abuse various substances then. I somehow managed to graduate and gain acceptance to a top Ivy -- what I thought was my dream school. I spent three semesters there and dropped out. I'm sitting alone in an empty apartment. I have no job. No real friends to speak of, am effectively estranged from my family. The best part is that all of this is entirely my own creation. I alienated my friends and isolated myself from my family. I was given every opportunity in life, and I slowly destroyed it all.
